terminal.normalization: none; preserve complete parsed native JSON values
terminal.scope: one original-order offline native-batch grouped-array observation; corpus 24 of 24 candidates

numeric_worker_CPU_ledger.scope: wait4 measures complete worker user+system CPU through actual exit, including diagnostics; no sampling denominator. Request timers are disjoint calling-thread CPU. Remaining CPU includes startup/EOF/exit, instrumentation and any other worker threads. Supervisor CPU before receipt is separate. Missing receipts remain censored. This is numeric-service CPU accounting, not a whole-verification wall fraction.

metadata_coverage.product_scope: Generated polynomial products for direct; mirrored probe products or generated-proof ancestry for native fallback. Unknown metadata is not zero.

accelerable_cost.scope: Summed eligible interval wall deliberately overcounts overlap. Conditional on fixed certificates, fallback decisions and noneligible work. Only a fixed-work scheduling upper bound; union is observed occupancy, not critical-path saving. Generous bound additionally eliminates Lean product proof construction and internal exact LP, beyond a floating GPU's guarantee. No bound certified with missing attribution.

batching.scope: Client exported-AST or LP request intervals, including mutex wait; direct AST requests need product/LP construction before actual device-ready LP. Sequential future branches are excluded.

0.01.scope: Ranked complete four-source wave wall; individual-candidate wall is unavailable. Whole tied waves retained.

0.1.scope: Ranked complete four-source wave wall; individual-candidate wall is unavailable. Whole tied waves retained.

scope: Diagnostic capture, all success/fallback calls. Timers and JSON logging overhead are charged, not corrected away. Overlapping parent Lean LP CPU/service CPU are reported separately. Same-method native JSON agreement required separately. Root self-review.
